field_needs.required: The court needs it. Still never blocks the application: if the applicant does not know, that is recorded.
field_needs.if_known: Asked once; left empty if the applicant does not know.
field_needs.if_relevant: Asked only when the applicant's situation makes it apply.

if_unknown: Every question can be skipped. "I don't know" is recorded honestly and never guessed, and missing information or evidence never stops the applicant from generating the form.

steps.title: About you

questions.en: Let's start with you. What is your name, and how can the court contact you?

fields.label: Surname
Full names
ID number / date of birth
Home or temporary address
Home/contact telephone number, and cell phone number for application updates
Email address, or other social media account where the court can contact you
Would you prefer the matter to be heard through an audiovisual link (if available)? Contact for the link
Work address
Work telephone number
Nature of domestic relationship with the respondent
Occupation (including learner/student)

validation_rules: The ID number or date of birth is written as given; a date of birth is accepted when there is no ID number.
The relationship to the respondent must be a domestic relationship under the Act. If it is not, the applicant is told about a harassment order instead and referred.

steps.title: Someone applying for you
steps.applies: only when someone applies on behalf of the person who needs protection

questions.en: Are you filling this in for yourself, or for someone else?

fields.label: Surname and full names
Capacity (care giver, counsellor, educator, family member, health care personnel, medical practitioner, social worker, SAPS member, related person, other)
ID number / date of birth, email, work address and telephone, occupation
Reason(s) why the application is made on behalf of the victim
Written consent of the victim (obtained and attached, or why it is not necessary)

validation_rules: The written consent of the person who needs protection is required, or the reason it is not necessary is given.

steps.title: The person harming you

questions.en: Tell me about the person who is harming you. What is their name, and how are you related?

fields.label: Relationship to you (for example boyfriend, ex-husband, father, sister-in-law, co-resident)
Surname (if known)
Full names, or the name you know them by
ID number / date of birth if known, or estimated age
Home address (if known)
Home/work/other contact telephone number and cell phone number (if known)
Email address (if known)
Social media platforms, and the name, handle or number on each account (if known)
Work/school/study address (if known)
Occupation, including learner/student (if known)

validation_rules: The relationship is chosen from the official list on the form.
Unknown details are left empty, never guessed.

steps.title: Others affected
steps.applies: when children or other people are affected

questions.en: Is anyone else affected, such as children or other people living with you?

fields.label: 3.1 Children and adults sharing the residence (name, age, relationship to you)
3.2 How are these persons affected?
3.3 Do any of these persons have disabilities? Details
Name and contact details of any person who witnessed the incident

validation_rules: Children's details are limited to what the form asks for.

steps.title: What happened

questions.en: Can you tell me what happened most recently? Take your time.

fields.label: History of abuse (earlier incidents and how things have got worse)
Most recent incident: date
Most recent incident: place where it happened (or social media account details)
Most recent incident: details of what happened
Most recent incident: any injuries (including what was used)
Most recent incident: medical, psychological or other treatment received
Most recent incident: harm or damages caused
Previous incident: date
Previous incident: place where it happened
Previous incident: details of what happened
Previous incident: any injuries (including what was used)
Previous incident: treatment received
Previous incident: harm or damages caused
Other information the court should know

validation_rules: Dates are real dates and not in the future, or "I don't remember exactly" with the closest time given.
Statements are in the first person and call the other person "the respondent".
Only facts the applicant gave: nothing added, softened or strengthened.
Everything is written in English for the court.

steps.title: Why it is urgent

questions.en: Why do you need protection now? Are you still living in the same place, and are there weapons in the house?

fields.label: Why is the application urgent?
Any other reasons why you need a protection order today?
Are you still staying in the same place as the respondent?
Are there firearms or other weapons in the house? Details
Does the respondent carry or have access to a firearm for work or other activities? Details
Do you fear for your life or safety, or that of your children, relatives or others? Details
Does the respondent use drugs, needing referral to a substance abuse treatment centre? Details

validation_rules: Weapons and fear for safety are always asked about, because they bear on the interim order.

steps.title: What the order should stop

questions.en: What should the order stop the respondent from doing?

fields.label: (a) Not to commit or attempt to commit these acts towards the complainant
(b) Not to get the help of another person to commit any of these acts
(c) Not to enter the shared residence, situated at
(d) Not to enter a specified part of the shared residence, namely
(e) Not to enter the complainant's residence, situated at
(f) Not to enter the complainant's workplace or place of studies, namely
(g) Not to prevent the complainant or any child who lives or lived in the shared residence from entering or remaining in it
(h) Not to disclose or make available any electronic communication, especially
(i) Not to commit any other act, namely

validation_rules: At least one of the protections (a) to (i) is chosen.
Protections are offered as the form's own tick list.

steps.title: Extra conditions

questions.en: Do you also need help with money, rent, maintenance, weapons, collecting belongings, or keeping your address secret?

fields.label: (a) A peace officer to accompany the complainant to collect personal property
(b) A member of SAPS to seize these weapons in the possession of the respondent
(c) Respondent to pay interim rent or mortgage payments until the return date
(d) Respondent to pay interim maintenance until the return date
(e) Respondent to pay interim emergency monetary relief until the return date (food, transport, medical, counselling, school fees, relocation, household bills)
(f) Respondent refused any contact with these children until the return date
(g) Respondent granted this contact with the children until the return date
(h) The complainant's home, study or work details not to be disclosed to the respondent
(i) Other conditions requested

validation_rules: Money requests are offered as a tick list.
Keeping the address secret is a yes or no question.

steps.title: Personal property
steps.applies: only when the applicant needs to collect belongings

questions.en: Are there belongings you need to collect from the home, with a police officer?

fields.label: Property description, why it is your personal property, and the address where it is kept

steps.title: Police station, court and documents

questions.en: Which police station would you report to if the order is broken, and which court can you get to?

fields.label: I am likely to report a breach of the protection order at this police station
The court I will be able to attend
Documents I will attach (photos, medical records, screenshots, witness statements)

validation_rules: Evidence is never required to apply; documents are listed only if the applicant has them.
